diagnoses.analysis: The required-status-check is an aggregate gate, not a separate build defect. Its exit 1 follows the common build failure: reusable-pr-build.yml:62-89 requires needs.common.result to be success. Correcting the PR-introduced Jedis helper-test Checkstyle violations resolves the underlying cause; the gate itself needs no changes.

The frozen common build fails on AvoidEscapedUnicodeCharacters in the newly introduced Jedis 2.0 and 3.0 JedisErrorTypeTest fixtures. Replace the unnecessary Unicode escape with the identical literal character in those two tests and the analogous Jedis 4.0 fixture, which would violate the same rule when reached. UTF-8 compilation is already configured. The focused Checkstyle tasks now have zero violations, and all 75 tests across the three affected unit suites pass without changing runtime string values or production behavior.

Classify Redis server errors for Jedis 2, 3, and 4+ on spans and database duration metrics. A confirmed `WRONGTYPE details` reply produces `error.type="WRONGTYPE"`.

Preserve usable ASCII prefixes verbatim. Dedicated server exceptions, non-ASCII or missing prefixes, and client failures retain exception-class fallback. Successful operations omit `error.type`.

Propagate actual failures through command, pipeline, and transaction completion, including error results returned inside batches.
